WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY "segment"
),
percentages AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "consumption_2012",
        "consumption_2013",
        (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") / "consumption_2013") * 100 AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM pivoted
    WHERE "segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
)

SELECT
    'biggest' AS "type",
    "segment",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM percentages
ORDER BY "percentage_increase" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'lowest' AS "type",
    "segment",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM percentages
ORDER BY "percentage_increase" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
